description.value: Hike-in wilderness camp on a subalpine lake within Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park, set below old-growth forested slopes and spectacular alpine ridges roughly 150 km east of Vancouver. No fires permitted in the backcountry, cell service ends well before the trailhead, and the trailhead parking lot is a noted break-in target.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Lindeman Lake Camp as a backcountry tent camp within Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Provincial Park; OSM tags (tents=yes, drinking_water=no, shower=no, washing_machine=no, toilets=yes, openfire=no) provide the primary amenity evidence and are consistent with the BC Parks website description of a hike-in backcountry wilderness camp. The website confirms advance online permit registration is required and available, partially contradicting the OSM reservation=no tag — however the website clarifies this is a permit system (permits cannot sell out) rather than a traditional site reservation. The website also explicitly warns that the Lindeman Lake parking lot is subject to break-ins, which is a significant concern for touring cyclists needing secure bike storage.
concerns: Hike-in backcountry camp only — no cycling access to the campsite; cyclists must leave bikes at the trailhead.

BC Parks website explicitly warns: 'Lindeman Lake parking lot is subject to break-ins. Do not leave anything of value in your vehicle.' This directly affects the security of any bikes or gear left at the trailhead.
No potable water on site (drinking_water=no); campers must carry or treat water from natural sources.

OSM reservation=no conflicts with website describing an advance online permit registration system; the permit system is not traditional site-specific reservation but advance registration is available and required.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Lindeman Lake Camp is a hike-in-only backcountry camp with no cycling access to the campsite itself; cyclists would need to leave bikes and gear at a trailhead parking lot that BC Parks explicitly warns is subject to break-ins, making this a poor fit for most touring cyclists without further evidence of cycle-specific access or storage.
enrichment_extras.notes: The linked website covers all four backcountry lake camps in the park (Lindeman, Greendrop, Flora, Radium); Lindeman-specific detail is limited to passing mentions. No address or phone number available in OSM.

wow_evidence: hike-in wilderness camp on a subalpine lake within Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park; parking lot is subject to break-ins
